import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# Compute the daily average photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio for each station
# Ratio = O3 / NO2 (both in µg/m³)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.id as station_id,
    aqs.name_en as station_name,
    aqs.station_type,
    COUNT(*) as hours_count,
    AVG(hsaq.o3 / hsaq.no2) as mean_ratio,
    AVG(hsaq.o3) as mean_o3,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as mean_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq

AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
AND hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL
AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
AND hsaq.no2 > 0  -- Avoid division by zero
GROUP BY aqs.id, aqs.name_en, aqs.station_type
ORDER BY mean_ratio DESC
""")

print("Station ratios (sorted by ratio descending):")
